projects.title: Bus Network Path Search
bullets: Implemented shortest-path queries using Python and NetworkX for public urban bus networks during a supervised undergraduate independent study.
Tested disconnected graph cases and compared search times on sampled graphs as part of the supervised path-search project.

projects.title: Multimodal Transit Graph Comparison
bullets: Constructed graphs from public multimodal transit route tables using Python and NetworkX in a supervised undergraduate team course project.
Compared search times on sampled transportation graphs as my contribution to the course project's path-search comparison.
